Overview: 
 Draper is an independent, nonprofit research and development company headquartered in Cambridge, MA. The 2,000+ employees of Draper tackle important national challenges with a promise of delivering successful and usable solutions. From military defense and space exploration to biomedical engineering, lives often depend on the solutions we provide. Our multidisciplinary teams of engineers and scientists work in a collaborative environment that inspires the cross-fertilization of ideas necessary for true innovation. For more information about Draper, visit www.draper.com . 
 
 Job Description Summary: 
A Systems Analysis Engineer 2 develops and applies advanced Digital Engineering capabilities for the analysis of complex systems in domains such as: strategic deterrence, missile defense, hypersonics, space, precision guided munitions, autonomous air/sea vehicles, and biotechnology. Our multi-disciplinary teams innovate and develop solutions for full system development lifecycle from trade studies, to concept and architecture design, to integration, to testing and operation.

Responsibilities:

•Independent and collaborative engineering development

•Flexibility to adapt to changes in program priorities

•Adhering to to existing best practices and Quality Management System processes.

•Work within multi-disciplinary teams and independently execute assignments

•Drive solutions to complex problems with limited direction

•Lead small teams (few than five people) and align team towards program goals.

•Provide insight and suggestions for design modifications and program execution based on analysis outcomes, and to apply analysis techniques across a range of technical challenges

•Identify program/system-level technical risks and develop and execute mitigation strategies.

•Mentor less experienced engineers and provide thoughtful, constructive feedback 
 Job Description: 
 Duties/Responsibilities 
• Performs analysis approaches for a particular problem and independently execute assignments.
• Independently execute system engineering lifecycle assignments; concept and architecture design, integration, testing and operation. 
• Contribute high quality content for technical reports and presentations with minimal guidance
• Proactively identify needs and concerns associated with design decisions and communicate them to project leadership
• Contribute to the updates of best practices and processes to reflect the most up to date tools and procedures. 
• Work in a collaborative multidisciplinary environment including stakeholders and external partners.
• Contribute to translation of requirements into technical and architectural decisions.
• Performs other duties as assigned.

 Skills/Abilities 
• Excellent mathematical skills.
• Thorough understanding of engineering theories and procedures.
• Ability to collaborate within a diverse and multidisciplinary team.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
• Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
• Excellent time management skills with the proven ability to meet deadlines.
• Ability to become knowledgeable in various problem domains, identify relevant modeling and analysis techniques, and develop or integrate multi-domain qualitative models.
• Ability to present results that support system-level analysis, performance trade-offs, and decision-making is critical, thus communications and interpersonal skills are highly valued in this role.
• The ability to communicate technical concepts effectively with customers, engineers, managers, and other stakeholders of all relevant disciplines is a must.
• Flexibility to multi-task and adapt to evolving priorities.
• Knowledge and interest in interdisciplinary work spanning Systems Engineering, Model based Systems Engineering (MBSE), Trade Space Exploration (TSE), Machine Learning and Data Science.

 Education 
Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace, Electrical, Mechanical, or other relevant Engineering field. Master's degree preferred.

 Experience 
• Requires 3-5 years experience in systems analysis or related.
• Experience in use of MBSE tools such as SysML, knowledge in MATLAB/Simulink. 
• Experience in integrating descriptive modeling tools with other simulation tools.

 
 Additional Job Description: 
 Successful candidates will have the majority of required and, some to many, of the desired and preferred abilities listed below:
 Required: Demonstrated prior performance both academically and professionally
 Strong presentation skills
 Strong organization and resource tracking skills
 Bootstrapping, developing, and learning new skills independently
 Familiarity and interest in GPS hardware and software development
 Familiarity with Kalman filtering or other modern estimation methods
 Familiarity with requirements development and systems analysis
 Familiarity with modeling and simulation frameworks, Python/C++/Java, descriptive modeling (e.g. SysML), Matlab, and/or other engineering analysis tools
 
 Desired: Hardware and software in the loop testing
 Prior experience with GPS/INS integrated systems
 Navigation algorithm development
 Covariance/accuracy analysis
 
 Preferred: Curiosity and a genuine interest in developing familiarity with project needs, both programmatic and technical
 Willingness to learn, ask questions, and seek guidance
 Collaboration both in person and remotely (e.g. Teams, Git, Confluence, etc.)
 Ability to verbalize thought process and accept input
 Experience with Model Based Systems Engineering
 Values the dedicated workspace and atmosphere of an in-person development environment
 
 
 Applicants selected for this position will be required to obtain and maintain a government security clearance.
